name: Delta Access Expansion
monitor_reason: length: no sourced pipe length; add-threshold 25 km rule cannot be met. Sponsor (Williams) and endpoints (Gillis LA east along Transco corridor toward Plaquemines) are known; Williams sanctioned it in August 2026.
researcher_notes: Williams announced the Delta Access project in early August 2026 alongside its Momentum Midstream purchase. It is a 1.5 billion dollar expansion of the Transco system starting at Gillis, Louisiana and running east along the Transco corridor. Initial capacity is 2.25 Bcf/d with options to 3.5 Bcf/d. Target in-service is early 2029. Natural Gas Intelligence (12 Aug 2026) says it is headed toward Venture Global's Plaquemines LNG and would connect into the Cloud Connector line. The Enerdata and Journal of Petroleum Technology articles repeat the Williams announcement, so they are one origin. No pipe length, diameter, mileage or Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket was found. It is not in the EIA August 2026 release. Not a match to existing rows: P5115 Louisiana Energy Gateway is Haynesville to Gillis gathering, now operating; P7108 Southeast Supply Enhancement is Virginia to Alabama; P7808 Gillis West is a 115 MMcf/d interconnect with no new pipe; P0193 and P3193 Gator Express are Venture Global lines. Revisit when Williams files with FERC or states a length. If it adds 25 km or more, stage as PipelineName Transcontinental Gas Pipeline, SegmentName Delta Access Project. Capacity stated in Bcf/d as the sources say. Cost 1500000000 USD. No route found.
